title: Candidate Screening
summary: Every application parsed, ranked and shortlisted, with the reasons shown.
headline: Shortlists that arrive *with their reasons*
lede: Every application is read, structured and scored against the role profile your panel agreed. Recruiters open a ranked list where each position can be explained in a sentence.

capabilities.title: Resume Parsing
capabilities.body: Turn PDFs, Word files and scanned resumes into clean, structured profiles without retyping a line.
points: Handles mixed layouts and multiple languages
Work history, education and certifications extracted
Original document always one click away

capabilities.title: Skill Extraction
capabilities.body: Identify the skills a candidate has actually used, how recently and for how long, rather than the ones listed in a keyword block.
points: Skills tied to the roles they were used in
Related skills recognised, such as React and Next.js
Gaps against the role profile flagged

capabilities.title: AI Candidate Matching
capabilities.body: Score each candidate against the requirements of the role, weighting the criteria the way your hiring manager set them.
points: The same rubric applied to every candidate

capabilities.title: Candidate Ranking
capabilities.body: See the whole applicant pool in order, with matched and missing skills side by side for each person.
points: Re-ranks when the role profile changes

capabilities.title: Smart Shortlisting
capabilities.body: Propose a shortlist for recruiter review. Nobody is rejected by the model; a person confirms every decision.
points: Suggested shortlist with the evidence attached
Borderline candidates queued for a human look

outcomes.label: of manual resume screening removed from recruiter workload
to score 214 applications on one requisition
candidates rejected without a human review
